item.title: TIL: Browsers offer a “copy email” in the context menu on mailto: links
item.content:encoded: When adding an email link to a document you should use the mailto: URI scheme: Email Chris That makes the browser open the associated email tool instead of opening the link in the browser. Today I found out that browsers also offer a “copy email” in the context menu that only copies the email itself […]
